# Variant calls preparation

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

## 1. General QC 

### Coverage General 

```{r}
## Cohort 2
coverage_2 <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_2_openbis/cohort_2_openbis_overview.tsv")
coverage_2$cohort <- "cohort_new"
coverage_2$tissue_treatment <- "FFPE"

## Cohort 1
coverage_1 <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/cohort_1_ena_overview.tsv")
coverage_1$cohort <- "cohort_old"

# Select tumor samples 
coverage_1 <- coverage_1 %>% filter(sample_type == "TU")
coverage_1$sample <- coverage_1$sample_title

## Combine
colnames_shared <- colnames(coverage_1)[colnames(coverage_1) %in% colnames(coverage_2)]

coverage_all <- rbind(coverage_1 %>% select(all_of(colnames_shared)), coverage_2 %>% select(all_of(colnames_shared)))
```


```{r}
# Select columns of interest
coverage_filtered <- coverage_all %>% select(sample, cohort, multiqc_general.median_coverage, multiqc_general.mean_coverage,multiqc_general.5_x_pc, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.median_coverage, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.mean_coverage, rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc)
```


```{r}
## MOSDEPTH coverage across gene panel

ggplot(coverage_filtered, aes(x = multiqc_general.median_coverage))+

  theme_classic()+

# 5x coverage percentage
ggplot(coverage_filtered, aes(x = multiqc_general.5_x_pc))+

  geom_rug(aes(color = cohort))+
  theme_classic()+
```

#### Correlation Mean / Target Coverage 

```{r}
coverage_comp <- data.frame(sample = coverage_filtered$sample, mean_cov = coverage_filtered$multiqc_general.mean_coverage, mean_cov_rcc = coverage_filtered$rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.mean_coverage)

spearman_test <- cor.test(coverage_comp$mean_cov, coverage_comp$mean_cov_rcc)

ggplot(coverage_comp, aes(mean_cov, mean_cov_rcc))+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "darkgrey")+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Pearson = ",round(spearman_test$estimate, digits = 2)))

coverage_comp <- data.frame(sample = coverage_filtered$sample, mean_cov = coverage_filtered$multiqc_general.5_x_pc, mean_cov_rcc = coverage_filtered$rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc)

spearman_test <- cor.test(coverage_comp$mean_cov, coverage_comp$mean_cov_rcc)

ggplot(coverage_comp, aes(mean_cov, mean_cov_rcc))+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "darkgrey")+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Pearson = ",round(spearman_test$estimate, digits = 2)))
```


#### Filter criteria 

```{r}
## Average coverage per PID
coverage_filtered$PID <- str_split(coverage_filtered$sample, "_TU", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Here for overall mean coverage
coverage_PID <- coverage_filtered %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarise(mean_cov = mean(multiqc_general.mean_coverage), 
                                                                  cov_rcc_5 = mean(rcc_targets_mosdepth_mqc.generalstats.mosdepth.5_x_pc))
coverage_PID <- coverage_PID %>% mutate(PID_kick_out = ifelse(cov_rcc_5 < 15, TRUE, FALSE))
```

```{r}
## Since these patients did not show particular patterns, they are retained in the analysis thus far
PID_kick_out <- coverage_PID %>% filter(cov_rcc_5 < 15) %>% pull(PID) #n=5
```

### Save 

```{r}
write_csv(coverage_PID, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/coverage_PID_QC.csv")
```


## 2. Cohort 2 - OpenBIS 

### Per patient

```{r}
path <- c("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_2_openbis/02_variant_calling/variant_tables/")

# List all files
files <- list.files(path)

# Extract ID
PID <- str_split(files, "_B", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
# Create combined variant table 
variant_combined <- foreach(i = seq_along(files), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
   variant_table <- read_tsv(paste0(path, files[i]))
  # Add ID 
  variant_table$PID <- PID[i]
  # Add type (SNV, Indel) and consequence from Annotation 
  variant_table$variant_type <- str_split(variant_table$Annotation,"[|;]", simplify = TRUE)[,12]
  variant_table$variant_consequence <- str_split(variant_table$Annotation,"\\|", simplify = TRUE)[,4]
  return(variant_table)
}
```

#### Match identifiers

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)

patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")
```

```{r}
ID_match_new <- data.frame(PID_old =unique(variant_combined$PID))

ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID_old, "B0", "B200")
ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "B1", "B201")
ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "B9", "B199")

ID_match_new$PID <- str_replace(ID_match_new$PID, "_",".")        
ID_match_new$PID <- str_split(ID_match_new$PID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

ID_match_new$PID_in_IMC <- ID_match_new$PID %in% patient_meta$PID

write_csv(ID_match_new, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/cohort2_PID_matching.csv")
```

### Filter 

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv") #Downloaded: 10 April 2024
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
```

```{r}
# Split genes column into two rows in case it contains two gene names
variant_combined <- variant_combined %>%
  separate_rows(Genes, sep = ";") %>%
  unnest(cols = everything())

# Check variants called with VAF == 100 
## Possible to filter out - Potential SNPs 
vaf_100 <- variant_combined %>% filter(Frequency == 100)
vaf_100_GOI <- vaf_100 %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI)
## Optional: 
#variant_combined <- variant_combined %>% filter(Frequency != 100)

# Pick first mutation consequence 
variant_combined$variant_consequence_clean <- str_split(variant_combined$variant_consequence,"&", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

#### Variant reads and VAF

```{r}
# Option 1 (selected - more sensitive):
variant_combined <- variant_combined %>% filter(AllelicDepthAlt>=2 & Frequency>5)

# Option 2:
#variant_combined <- variant_combined %>% filter(AllelicDepthAlt>=5 & Frequency > 5)
```

#### Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact only 
ENSEMBL-based; See: https://grch37.ensembl.org/info/genome/variation/prediction/predicted_data.html

```{r}
unique(variant_combined$variant_consequence_clean)

# Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact
mutation_consequence <- c("splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","stop_gained","frameshift_variant","stop_lost","start_lost","inframe_insertion","inframe_deletion","missense_variant","protein_altering_variant")

variant_combined_filtered <- variant_combined %>% filter(variant_consequence_clean %in% mutation_consequence)
```

```{r}
vaf_100 <- variant_combined_filtered %>% filter(Frequency == 100)
vaf_100_GOI <- vaf_100 %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI)
```

```{r}
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined <- variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_clean

variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("stop_gained", "stop_lost","start_lost")] <- "stop_gained_lost_start_lost" 
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("splice_donor_variant", "splice_acceptor_variant")] <- "splice_site"
variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined[variant_combined_filtered$variant_consequence_combined %in% c("inframe_deletion", "inframe_insertion")] <- "inframe_del_ins"
```

```{r}
write_csv(variant_combined_filtered, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_filtered_cohort2.csv")
```

### Oncoprint

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_combined_filtered
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.width=10,fig.height=6}
# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen= setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat= setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

##Annotation
#Colors
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "protein_altering_variant")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

#Plot oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                    row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                    alter_fun = fun_alter,
                    col = col)

draw(ht_all)
```

#### Filter

```{r}
# Filter for patients for which we have IMC data
variant_combined <- variant_combined %>% filter(!is.na(PID))
```

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
```

```{r}
# Split genes column into two rows in case it contains two gene names
variant_combined <- variant_combined %>%
  separate_rows(Genes, sep = ";") %>%
  unnest(cols = everything())

# Check variants called with VAF == 100 
## Possible to filter out - Potential SNPs 
vaf_100 <- variant_combined %>% filter(Frequency == 100)
vaf_100_GOI <- vaf_100 %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI)

# Pick first mutation consequence 
variant_combined$variant_consequence_clean <- str_split(variant_combined$variant_consequence,"&", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
```

### Consensus per patient

```{r}
# Option 1: Consensus per PID 
### Only select mutations that were detected in both samples (n=2) - independent of mutation type
consensus <- variant_combined %>% group_by(PID, sample_id) %>% select(Genes) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID, Genes) %>% dplyr::count() %>% filter(n == 2)

variant_consensus <- foreach(i = unique(variant_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  genes_consensus <- consensus %>% filter(PID == i) %>% pull(Genes)
  variant_consensus <- variant_combined %>% filter(PID == i & Genes %in% genes_consensus)
  return(variant_consensus)
}
```


```{r}
# Option 2: Clonality annotation per PID
### If mutation is found in both samples - "Clonal" - Otherwise "Subclonal"
clonality <- variant_combined %>% group_by(PID, sample_id) %>% filter(!is.na(PID)) %>% select(Genes) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID, Genes) %>% dplyr::count() %>% mutate(clonality = ifelse(n == 1, "subclonal", "clonal"))

clonality_consensus <- foreach(i = unique(variant_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  variant_consensus <- variant_combined %>% filter(PID == i)
  clonality_consensus <- clonality %>% filter(PID == i)
  variant_consensus$clonality <- clonality_consensus$clonality[match(variant_consensus$Genes, clonality_consensus$Genes)]
  return(variant_consensus)
}
```

```{r}
clonality_plot <- clonality_consensus %>% group_by(PID, clonality) %>% dplyr::count() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n)) %>% filter(clonality == "clonal")

ggplot(clonality_plot, aes(x = clonality, y = fra))+
  geom_jitter(size = 2, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1), aes(color = PID))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Clonal mutation percentage (all)")
```


```{r}
write_csv(variant_consensus, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_consensus_cohort1.csv")
write_csv(clonality_consensus, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_clonality_consensus_cohort1.csv")
```

#### Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact only 
ENSEMBL-based - See: https://grch37.ensembl.org/info/genome/variation/prediction/predicted_data.html

```{r}

# Variants with MODERATE or HIGH impact
mutation_consequence <- c("splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","stop_gained","frameshift_variant","stop_lost","start_lost","inframe_insertion","inframe_deletion","missense_variant","protein_altering_variant")
```

#### Oncoprint

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_consensus_filtered
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
#Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))


# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- variant_consensus_filtered %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.width=15,fig.height=10}
# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen= setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat= setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

##Annotation
#Colors
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(1.3, "char"), pch = 0),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "protein_altering_variant")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

#Plot oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE)

draw(ht_all)
```

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)

patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")

# Re-group subtypes 
patient_meta$subtype_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), patient_meta$subtype, "other")
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
patient_meta$subtype_combined[patient_meta$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

## Update survival censoring
patient_meta$status_OS <- ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

patient_meta$OS_months <- patient_meta$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
patient_meta$pT_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$pT_simple))

### ISUP grade 
patient_meta$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(patient_meta$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", patient_meta$ISUP))
patient_meta$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(patient_meta$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", patient_meta$lymphocytes)
```

```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
                           pT_combined = c_anno$pT_combined, 
                           necrose = c_anno$necrose,
                           PDL1 = c_anno$PDL1_score,
                           col = list(ISUP_combined = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined,
                                      pT_combined = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined,
                                      necrose = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose, 
                                      PDL1 = PDL1_col),
                           border = TRUE
                           )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

  
## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  #column_split = c_anno$cohort,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v% ca %v% ca_PID #%v% ca_prog
  

draw(ht_all)
```


#### SNV / CNV 

```{r}
full_consensus_GOI <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/SNV_CNV_combined_full_withmeta.csv")
```

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- full_consensus_GOI

# Optional: Filter low-cov patients
#snv <- snv %>% filter(!PID_old %in% PID_kick_out)

snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1", "STAG2", "ELOC", "ARHGAP35")]

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- full_consensus_GOI %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```

```{r}
saveRDS(mut_list_full, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/SNV_CNV_mutlist.rds")
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
## Step 1: Define alteration function

#Colors
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "DELETION", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "AMPLIFICATION", "protein_altering_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost")

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  DELETION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  AMPLIFICATION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[8], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 8),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
c_anno$cohort <- full_consensus_GOI$cohort[match(c_anno$PID, full_consensus_GOI$PID)]

c_anno$gender <- full_consensus_GOI$gender[match(c_anno$PID, full_consensus_GOI$PID)]
c_anno$age_bin <- full_consensus_GOI$age_bin[match(c_anno$PID, full_consensus_GOI$PID)]

## 2A: Sequencing related data
### Define colors
cohort_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Set1")[1:2],unique(c_anno$cohort))

ca <- columnAnnotation(cohort = c_anno$cohort,
                   #mean_cov = c_anno$mean_cov,
                   #cov_status = as.character(c_anno$critical),
                   col = list(cohort = cohort_col),
                   border = TRUE
                   )

## 2A: Patient metadata
ca_PID <- columnAnnotation(gender = c_anno$gender,
                           age_bin = c_anno$age_bin,
                           col = list(gender = metadata(sce)$colors$gender, 
                                      age_bin = metadata(sce)$colors$age_bin),
                           border = TRUE
                           )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

  
## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  #column_split = c_anno$cohort,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v% ca %v% ca_PID #%v% ca_prog
  

draw(ht_all)
```
